map.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: unlabeled landscape background for an editable Atlas VTT regional scene.
Create an exquisite hand-painted cartographic diorama called Forkwater, a quiet estuary where a river forks around a central green island. Landscape 3:2 composition, bird's-eye view with gently pictorial buildings, north up. This is a believable fantasy working landscape, not a user interface or a diagram.
The river enters near the top center, splits into two broad navigable teal channels around the central island, and opens toward the bottom. Left bank: a weathered stone archive with a small copper dome and old wharf around x22%,y35%. Central island: a wide open pale-sand council clearing around x50%,y52%, with sparse low grass and a single old tree toward its upper edge. Right bank: a compact survey camp with canvas shelters, wooden tables, and a lantern mast around x78%,y35%. Lower right: a quiet small landing stage around x75%,y76%. Narrow footpaths connect places along the banks; no giant bridge across the fork. The top and lower margins include broad quiet grass/sand/water zones for native editable titles and captions.
Style: sophisticated watercolor and gouache on subtly textured warm ivory paper, fine dark ink contours, restrained rich teal water, ochre sand, moss green, copper and terracotta roofs. Gentle afternoon light. Crisp landmark silhouettes, atmospheric details concentrated at landmarks, plenty of uncluttered open space for movable tabletop pieces. Beautiful crafted RPG map, no photographic realism, no science fiction, no cyberpunk, no dashboard panels. Keep camera and terrain coherent.
Absolutely no text, lettering, numbers, labels, labels-on-signs, symbols resembling UI buttons, compass rose, grid, tokens, characters, borders, watermarks or logo. Do not paint routes as arrows. The map will acquire all meaningful labels, moving pieces and links as editable native objects.

owl.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square portrait artwork for a movable Atlas VTT token.
A single thoughtful barn owl cartographer, front three-quarter bust, expressive dark eyes, cream heart-shaped face, warm russet feathers, a dark teal travel mantle and a small brass compass clasp. The character is an emblem for an investigator, not a logo. Fine ink and opaque watercolor/gouache illustration, warm ivory and copper against deep desaturated teal, sophisticated illustrated fantasy atlas style. Strong readable silhouette and face at tiny tabletop size. Center the face at 50%,44%; show shoulders; leave an even modest margin; make the head occupy most of the square.
Background is a simple dark teal softly textured field, not a scene. No circular frame, no border, no text, no labels, no watermark, no status marks, no interface. Native Atlas will supply the frame and editable name. Square composition, intended 1024 by 1024 pixels.
